dedupe_keys.name: operator learning for macroscopic traffic speed forecasting scm deeponet

description: Operator Learning for Macroscopic Traffic Speed Forecasting is a research model implemented by the authors of the associated study in the public GitHub repository jbnu55343/scm_deeponet. It uses a Deep Operator Network to predict short-term traffic speed from recent sensor speeds and traffic-flow or boundary features. The repository describes tests with SUMO-generated scenarios and METR-LA, a Los Angeles benchmark with 207 sensors. Its spatial coverage includes the Los Angeles sensor network and a separate Shanghai SUMO network; the README does not state METR-LA study dates or measurement interval. It includes Python training and preprocessing scripts, scenario definitions, and result logs; the README identifies Python 3.10 and PyTorch 2.0. The code is publicly browsable at no charge, but no reuse licence was stated in the inspected README and repository root listing. The repository describes paths for generated or preprocessed data, but the root listing does not confirm a separate data release. No code was installed or run, and no data or archive was downloaded. The model supports short-term traffic-flow forecasting and road-network operations studies. It is related to the METR-LA traffic benchmark record data-metr-la-pems-bay-traffic-benchmarks.
